title: 第1018章 离开靖安城再回万兽山脉第1017章 炼丹制符离开玄灵界
content_zh:
“八级阵法？！”
楚峰眉头一皱。
他本以为刘安已经放弃了。
却没想到，竟然将阵法布置在了庞烈感知之外的区域。
楚峰也没有想到会如此，便直接一头撞了上去。
“就这破阵法，也想要拦住我？”
楚峰冷笑一声，心念一动，一具傀儡便出现在了身边。
“去！”
他手臂一挥，傀儡便飞向另外一边。
“给我爆！”
傀儡光芒一闪，随即轰然爆炸开来。
咔嚓一声响起，阵法护罩上顿时出现了一道道蛛网般的裂纹。
“吞天造化诀，给我吞！”
楚峰将手掌贴在满是裂痕的阵法护罩上，随即猛地一吸。
原本依然破碎不堪的阵法，顿时轰然崩塌。
“嗯？来得这么快！”
楚峰抬头看向远方，那里几道强大的气息正极速赶来。
他双指并拢，对着身前的空间轻轻一划。
剑光一闪，空间顿时被划破出一道裂缝。
而就在这一刻，一道怒喝声忽然从远方传来：

“贼人，休要逃！空间封锁！”
靖安城城主虽然还未赶来，但却对着飞升通道出口空间虚空一握，空间被封锁。
但已经晚了一步，楚峰已然进入了空间裂缝之中。
“你们留下守住飞升通道，本城主去追他！”
靖安城城主撕裂空间，追了进去。
然而，他刚刚进入乱流空间，却见一具傀儡出现在了他身前。
“不好！”
他脸色顿时大变。
调动全身灵力护住全身。
轰！
傀儡猛然爆炸开来。
原本即将闭合的空间裂缝，再度被撕开。
巨大的冲击波将城主掀翻，气血更是一阵翻涌。
“好胆！”
他擦了擦嘴角的鲜血，看着空无一人的乱流空间，随后冲出了空间裂缝，回到了靖安城飞升通道前。
“城主！”
之前跟随他来的统领等人连忙上前行礼。
“此人究竟是谁？难道是那个姓庞的？”
靖安城城主立刻传信给靖西王刘安，将此事上报。
content_en:
"Eighth level formation?!"
Chu Feng frowned.
He thought Liu An had given up.
But he didn't expect that the formation would be arranged in an area beyond Pang Lie's perception.
Chu Feng didn't expect this, so he bumped into it.
"You want to stop me just by breaking the formation?"
Chu Feng sneered, and with a thought, a puppet appeared beside him.
"Go!"
With a wave of his arm, the puppet flew to the other side.
"Blow it up!"
The puppet's light flashed and then exploded.
There was a click, and spider web-like cracks suddenly appeared on the formation shield.
"Swallow the Heaven Creation Technique, swallow it for me!"
Chu Feng put his palm against the cracked formation shield, and then took a deep breath.
The formation, which was still in pieces, suddenly collapsed.
"Huh? It came so fast!"
Chu Feng raised his head and looked into the distance, where several powerful auras were approaching very quickly.
He put his fingers together and lightly drew the space in front of him.
With a flash of sword light, a crack opened in the space.
And at this moment, an angry shout suddenly came from the distance:
"Thieves, don't try to escape! Space is blocked!"
Although the Lord of Jingan City has not arrived yet, he grasped the void at the exit of the ascension channel and the space was blocked.
But it was already a step too late, Chu Feng had already entered the space crack.
"You stay and guard the ascension passage, while I, the city lord, go after him!"
The Lord of Jingan City tore apart the space and chased after him.
However, as soon as he entered the turbulent space, he saw a puppet appearing in front of him.
"Not good!"
His expression suddenly changed.
Mobilize the whole body's spiritual power to protect the whole body.
boom!
The puppet suddenly exploded.
The space crack that was about to close was torn open again.
The huge shock wave overturned the city lord, and his energy and blood surged.
"How brave!"
He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, looked at the empty turbulent space, and then rushed out of the space crack and returned to the ascension channel of Jingan City.
"City Lord!"
The commander and others who had followed him quickly stepped forward to salute.
"Who is this person? Is it the one named Pang?"
The lord of Jing'an City immediately sent a letter to Jingxi King Liu An to report the matter.
